findings.evidence: Sibling captures in the same uninterrupted pay-flow session show a hard contradiction: state 23-modal-pay-choice.png displays 'Total 1,50 € · TVA incluse' (cart had one Coca after re-add) and state 28-stripe-placeholder.png correctly displays '1,50 €' + 'PAYER 1,50 €' button confirming the cart total. BUT state 24-modal-pay-counter-confirm.png (counter-pay branch) displays 'TOTAL 33,00 €' on the ticket-retrait, 'PRÊT À 19h45' and order id '#C-1234'. DOM grep confirms hardcoded 'C-1234' (8 occurrences), '33,00' (3 occurrences) and '19h45' (2 occurrences). The Stripe branch reads cart state correctly; the counter branch renders a static demo ticket. From a paying customer's perspective, the cart said 1,50 € but the ticket they show at pickup says 33,00 € — a numeric inconsistency that breaks the entire fiscal trust contract of the pay flow, even before backend wire-up.
findings.fix_hint: ScreenConfirmation (route '11 Confirmation') must read the order total + ETA + order-id from a `currentOrder` state slot snapshotted at counter-pay confirmation, not from hardcoded demo constants. Mirror the binding the Stripe placeholder screen uses (which correctly shows the live total).

findings.evidence: States 24-modal-pay-counter-confirm.png and 25-confirm-screen.png are byte-identical: MD5 of both PNGs = 6e521dd50b61cc463c797b50b78b61a2, MD5 of both DOMs = 5d189ed90031d7a7256aeec66953aa29. The wave was meant to capture the modal-to-confirm transition (state 24) and then the settled confirm screen with order id / ETA / total assertions (state 25). Two distinct states are not actually evidenced — the spec snaps the same render twice without any intervening action. The reviewer therefore cannot distinguish 'modal closed → confirm appeared' from 'confirm settled with confetti dismissed'. Audit count of 28 distinct states is in practice 27.
findings.fix_hint: Between snap('24-modal-pay-counter-confirm') and snap('25-confirm-screen'), wait for the success animation to settle (or scroll the confirm screen) so the second capture has different state. Alternatively rename state 25 to '25-confirm-screen-after-modal-dismiss' and add an explicit dismissal step.

findings.evidence: Modal shows '+25 POINTS GAGNÉS' with copy '// BIENVENUE AU CLUB'. The cart total just paid was 1,50 € (Coca only, see state 23 modal Total = 1,50 €). The cart-screen loyalty preview at state 20 (multi-line 17,00 € cart) said '+17 pts gagnés sur cette commande' = 1 pt per €. By that same rule a 1,50 € purchase should yield ~1 or 2 pts, not 25. The ScreenCart preview and the post-confirm ModalPointsGain therefore use different (and contradicting) point-earning rules — or the modal is hardcoded to a 'first-order welcome bonus' of +25 without any indicator distinguishing welcome-bonus from per-order earnings. Either way, two surfaces of the same fact (loyalty points earned on this purchase) show different numbers.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) the modal copy should explicitly read 'BIENVENUE AU CLUB +25 pts d'inscription · +N pts sur ta commande' with N from the live cart, OR (b) the cart-preview earning rate must match the post-confirm modal (single source of truth in window.LC.loyalty.pointsFor(cartTotal)). Currently the +25 is a static literal in ModalPointsGain.

findings.evidence: Cart row for the Tacos XXL line shows ONLY the product title 'Tacos XXL (4 Viandes)' followed by '+ 0 suppléments' and the line total 15,50 €. The full wizard composition the user just built (Viandes: Merguez + Kefta + Cordon Bleu + Mexicain · Sauce: Algérienne · Formule: Menu complet · Boisson: Coca-Cola 33cl · Style frites: Nature · Sauce frites: Mayonnaise) is NOT rendered anywhere in the cart row. DOM grep of 17-cart-1-line.dom.html confirms 'Menu complet' appears 1 time and none of 'Algérienne / Mexicain / Merguez' appear at all — the composition is lost the moment the wizard finishes. A customer has zero way to verify what they configured for the 15,50 € line before tapping 'Valider ma commande'. This is also a regression risk: any wizard step that misfires will silently overcharge / undercharge with no visible audit trail. The '+ 0 suppléments' line is meaningless filler that emphasises the absence of the actual composition.
findings.fix_hint: ScreenCart cart-row template must render the composition summary string (built from the same selectionSummary helper the Wizard recap uses) below the product title, e.g. 'Algérienne · Menu complet · Coca-Cola 33cl · Frites Nature · Mayonnaise'. Replace '+ 0 suppléments' with this composition line; show '+ N suppléments' only when supplements are non-zero.

findings.evidence: State 18 (qty-plus) increments the Tacos line to qty=2 and the cart line total correctly shows 31,00 € (15,50 × 2 ✓) plus footer TOTAL 31,00 €. BUT the cart subtitle still reads '1 article · prêt dans ~12 min' instead of pluralising. State 20 (multi-line, qty=1 + qty=1 = 2 lines) correctly says '2 articles' — so the pluralisation rule is line-count-based, not quantity-based. By restaurant UX convention, 'X articles' on a cart subtitle is normally the total item count (Σ qty). The current rule means qty=2 on a single line is reported as '1 article' which understates the order to the customer.
findings.fix_hint: ScreenCart subtitle should compute totalItems = cart.reduce((s, l) => s + l.qty, 0), then pluralise: `${totalItems} article${totalItems > 1 ? 's' : ''}`. If a 'distinct items' count is also desired, render both: '2 articles · 1 ligne' or 'X article(s) · prêt dans ~Y min'.

findings.evidence: Empty cart state shows an illustration (small shopping-cart emoji-style icon), copy 'Ton panier est vide' + subcopy 'Faim ? Va voir le menu.' but NO primary CTA button. DOM grep of 22-cart-empty-state.dom.html: only 1 <button> in the entire document (the top-left back chevron). The subcopy 'Va voir le menu' is plain inline text, not a clickable element. Per REVIEWER_PROTOCOL category 5, an empty-state must contain illustration + copy ≥20 chars + primary CTA button/anchor; this state misses the CTA. User is left to tap the back chevron blindly or rely on the tab bar (which is hidden on the cart screen, confirmed by DOM showing no .lc-tab present).
findings.fix_hint: Add a primary 'Voir le menu' button under the 'Ton panier est vide' copy that calls go('menu') (or pops history). Use the standard .lc-btn orange-filled style so it reads as the obvious next action.

findings.evidence: Direct-add screen (no-wizard items) renders an oversized solid-black header band that occupies the top ~40% of the screen with a centred image-icon glyph and the raw item name 'Tiramisu' / 'Coca-Cola 33cl' rendered in low-contrast grey inside the black tile (state 08 and state 09). This is the empty <image-slot> fallback for items with no registered photo asset. Visually this looks like a developer placeholder, not a customer-ready screen. It also creates a perceived contrast problem: dark-grey text on near-black background.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) supply real product photography for direct-add items (Tiramisu, Coca-Cola, etc.) so the image-slot has a non-empty src, or (b) replace the missing-image fallback with the same emoji-on-cream tile pattern used in the wizard recap header (e.g. '🍰 TIRAMISU' on cream background), which would match the brand palette and avoid the giant black slab.

findings.evidence: Cart row's 80×80 image slot renders as a flat solid-black square with the raw item title visible in low-contrast inside it ('Tacos XXL (4 Viandes)' on state 17, 'Coca-Cola 33cl' on state 20). Same empty <image-slot> fallback as direct-add screens (C-007) but worse because the cart row is the customer's final order-review surface. Also flagged by Wave A finding A-002. Cross-surface consistency confirms the issue is systemic across the app — every product card without a registered image renders this placeholder. Console warning '<image-slot> without an id will not persist its dropped image' is present in console.json for state 17 (and every state), so the runtime is also reporting the missing assets.
findings.fix_hint: Same as C-007: supply assets or replace fallback with cream+emoji tile. Cart row should display an emoji-on-cream 80×80 tile when no image is available; this matches the wizard recap pattern.

findings.evidence: Below the cart line and the loyalty banner, a section header 'POUR ACCOMPAGNER ?' with an inline 'Notre conseil' link is rendered, but no product cards appear under the header in the visible viewport (state 17 and state 19). DOM has 14 'Frites' tokens scattered through the source (suggesting the upsell list is rendered somewhere) but at iPhone 14 viewport 390×844 nothing is visible between the header and the sticky total bar. Either the upsell carousel renders below the fold and was never scrolled into view, or the recommendations component is rendering empty/zero cards. In either case the section header advertises a feature the user does not see.
findings.fix_hint: Either render the upsell cards inline (horizontal scroll snap on mobile) so the cart screen's mid-section pulls cross-sell pieces above the fold, or hide the 'POUR ACCOMPAGNER ?' header when the upsell list is empty. Confirm via a follow-up snap that the cards actually render at 390×844.

findings.evidence: State 11's filename 'wings-fritessauce-confirmed-generic' implies the screenshot evidences the Wings 12 sauce step (or fritessauce step) with the 15 generic sauces visible and 'no BBQ/Nashville/Tex-Mex named variant'. The actual capture shows the SUPPLÉMENTS step of wings-12 ('ÉTAPE 2 / 3 SUPPLÉMENTS' with Jambon de dinde / Boursin / Fromage à raclette / Fromage / Œuf / Galette pommes de terre / Sauce supplémentaire), not the sauce step. The 'generic 15 sauces' assertion is in the spec's observations log (line 528) but is NOT evidenced in the PNG or DOM. State 13-ojja and state 14-salade-royale DO show the 15-sauce grid correctly — so the protocol can be satisfied via those captures, but state 11 itself fails to evidence what its filename promises. Also note that wings-12 is a snacking-template item: the brief asserts has_menu_addon=false and 'no frites_style step'; the captured supplements step is consistent with that, but the filename 'wings-fritessauce-confirmed-generic' is itself misleading because wings-12 has no fritessauce step in the active wizard.
findings.fix_hint: Either rename state 11 to '11-wings-12-supplements-after-bbq-sauce' to match what is shown, or move the snap() call to happen BEFORE the sauce-step CTA click so the screenshot evidences the sauce grid with the 15 generic options.

findings.evidence: The Wave C task brief stated that state 17 should show 'Tacos XXL line total 18€'. The actual engine-correct value for the configured selections (Tacos XXL 12,50 + Menu complet +3,00 + Coca 0 + Style Nature 0 + Mayonnaise first-free 0) = 15,50 €, which is what is rendered (cart line 15,50 €, cart total 15,50 €, loyalty preview +16 pts on 15,50€ = 1 pt/€ ✓). The GStack team explicitly captured this discrepancy in their self-report ('engine returns 15,50€ — Tacos XXL 12.50 + Menu Complet 3.00') and the math is correct per the selection set actually used. The brief's '18€' assumed additional selections (Œuf supp +1,00 + Cheddar fondu +1,00 + a paid sauce supplément +0,50) which are NOT in the spec's selection set for state 17. Brief discrepancy, not an app defect; GStack's interpretation is correct.
findings.fix_hint: Update Wave C brief / AUDIT_PLAN.md to reflect engine total 15,50 € for the state 17 cart-1-line selection set, OR update the spec's selection set to add Œuf (s-oeuf) + a paid sauce supplément to actually hit 18 €. Either path closes the discrepancy.

findings.evidence: Step indicator in the header shows 'ÉTAPE 8 / 8' for state 15 (Tacos XXL with frites-only formule = sauce 'Algérienne' + fritesStyle 'Nature' + fritesSauce 'Mayonnaise'). Counting the captured recap rows: VIANDES + SAUCE + FORMULE + STYLE FRITES + SAUCE FRITES = 5 composition rows, plus the implicit Crudités step (default ON, advanced past) and Suppléments step (skipped). That gives Viandes + Sauce + Crudités + Suppléments + Formule + StyleFrites + SauceFrites + Récap = 8 steps ✓. Consistent. For state 16 (boisson-only formule): VIANDES + SAUCE + FORMULE + BOISSON = 4 rows + Crudités + Suppléments + Récap = 7 steps ✓. Numeric step-count integrity is intact. Recorded for completeness; no defect.
findings.fix_hint: n/a — informational. Step counts and active-step machine output match the captured DOM.
